cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.argv = ['chain.py', '0', '1']
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import chain, harness, ref, json
fails=0
for seed in range(5):
    req, acc = chain.build(100+seed, ntx=600, D=200, G=40, pinned=0.9)
    got,_ = harness.run_request(req)
    want = ref.run(req)
    ok = got == want
    print('ok' if ok else 'FAIL', 'seed', seed, 'accepted', acc, 'rev', got['sessions'][0]['transactions'][-1]['revision'])
    if not ok:
        fails+=1
        tg=got['sessions'][0]['transactions']; tw=want['sessions'][0]['transactions']
        for j,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(tg,tw)):
            if a!=b:
                print(' tx',j,json.dumps(req['sessions'][0]['transactions'][j])[:400]); print(' got',json.dumps(a)[:400]); print(' want',json.dumps(b)[:400]); break
        break
print('fails',fails)
EOF
